correctness.rationale: Because every nonzero F_2^r vector occurs once as a column, selecting r independent parity checks and changing basis permutes the variable columns; all presentations reduce to r basis functionals plus t arbitrary extra functionals. Four columns labeled e1+e2,e2+e3,e3+e4,e4+e1 induce an unchorded 4-cycle without extra checks. The r=5 one-extra and r=6 one/two-extra obstructions reduce to all 31/63/1953 possibilities. The source enumerator uses an exact bit-parity support graph and MCS plus PEO verification; an independent implementation used networkx chordality, covering all 1953 r=6 pairs via 37 complete coordinate-permutation orbits, none chordal. The obstructions extend to higher r by induced coordinate restrictions. Adding checks on disjoint coordinate pairs yields a true-twin blowup of intersecting nonempty subsets of <=3 groups, a chordal graph, giving matching r<=6 constructions. The finite exhaustive part is a complete finite proof paired with analytic reduction, not a sampled experiment.
